observations: A gabled structure with multiple overlapping outline passes sits left of center; its roof plane is defined by brown and yellow-green lines that do not fully close at the corners.
Neon yellow-green marks run vertically across the entire image, densest at the edges, creating a loose frame that bleeds into the building's walls and the teal-blue zone above.
A pale blue-grey horizontal band below the structure reads as a flat plane; loose yellow and white lines float across it, echoing the vertical marks above.
reading: The building holds its shape through repeated, slightly misaligned outlines rather than solid fill, so the walls feel provisional. Orange verticals cut through olive and brown, keeping the structure from settling. The pale band below introduces a cooler stillness that sits in tension with the charged marks surrounding it. The image reads as unsettled shelter — present but not quite fixed.
